title: Light, shaped by you
description: Ask for the controls that matter to your design. Turn them yourself, watch Blender rebuild the geometry, and keep the directions you want to come back to.
prompt: Design a sculptural desk lamp from twisting ribbons. Give me Shape Lab controls for height, twist, ribbon count and finish, with sensible ranges. I want to explore the proportions myself and keep a few directions before the final render.
result: Real Blender session · shape a ribbon lamp and keep named design variants. Each preview builds real Blender geometry. Build time depends on the scene; previews stay separate from the main export until the next full build. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: A different kind of signal
description: Capture a circuit, turn a component value and overlay the new trace. Place two cursors around the part that interests you and keep the observations with the circuit that produced them.
prompt: Build a 100 Hz RC low-pass filter with a 1 kΩ resistor and 1 µF capacitor. Label the input and output nodes. I want to capture both in Scope Lab, double the resistance and compare the amplitude and timing.
result: Real CircuitJS solver · compare RC filter traces at 1 kΩ and 2 kΩ, measure and keep both. Each capture starts a separate native simulation from the current circuit export. It uses a fresh time origin; initial transients can differ. Keep both captures to preserve a comparison. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: Alpine Drift
description: Miss a jump, rewind and try another move. When something feels great or needs work, pin the exact moment so the agent can see what you mean.
prompt: Make a low-poly snowboarding game with pine trees, six golden gates, carving and jumping. Support Rewind and Try from here for the complete game state so I can retry a jump and pin precise playtest feedback.
result: Alpine Drift · a real playable run, rewind, retry and saved feedback. Rewind needs snapshot support in the authored game. Saved moments preserve compiled output; editable source stays in the project, and external assets still need their original service. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: One robot. Two futures.
description: Take one moment in a robot's run and see two futures unfold together. Change the ground, gravity or a sideways shove, then scrub to the moment they part ways.
prompt: Load the Unitree Go2 in MuJoCo. Let me pin a moment, apply a 100 N sideways shove for 0.15 seconds and compare the next three seconds with the original world. I want to inspect the greatest measured difference and keep a reproducible experiment.
result: Real Go2 session · 100 N shove · compare two futures and keep the experiment. Both futures use the same recorded controls. This compares open-loop physics; it does not rerun the Python controller. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: The shape of a molecule
description: Choose a flexible bond and move through its sampled shapes. Watch atoms approach one another, follow the calculated energy curve and keep a pose worth investigating.
prompt: Build 3D conformers of butane and phenethyl acetate with explicit hydrogens. Let me rotate a flexible bond in the acetate, compare the sampled shapes and rigid MMFF94 energy, then keep a pose and a reproducible study.
result: Phenethyl acetate · real rigid MMFF94 bond scan · 25 poses and a kept study. This is a rigid MMFF94 scan, with the other internal coordinates fixed. It does not establish a relaxed barrier, equilibrium population or biological activity. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: Lantern room
description: A track is an instrument you can play. Bring voices in and out, try a code change and mark the part you want to hear again. Keep the sound of that performance.
prompt: Write a warm 112 bpm synth groove with five named voices: Pulse drums, Sand noise, Low tide bass, Glass melody and Lantern chords. Let me bring voices in and out, mark a moment and keep a recording of my live performance.
result: Lantern room · real 112 bpm performance with audio · keep the WAV, source and markers. Takes capture up to two minutes of the instrument's output. The WAV preserves what you heard from it; external samples and custom imports are not bundled. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.

title: Light that travels
description: Hold a draft still while you read it. Quote a sentence, circle a detail or leave a page note, then compare the next draft without losing the one you reviewed.
prompt: Make a three-page Typst design brief for a portable reading light, with a proportion sketch, provisional targets and open questions. I want to hold the PDF, annotate text and areas, then compare a revision without losing the draft I reviewed.
result: Portable light · real Typst PDF · anchored notes carried into a later revision. Changed or repeated quotations need human inspection. Area and page notes stay with the reviewed PDF. The packet includes the PDF and feedback; editable source stays in the workspace. Fork includes the editable project; Codex is the selected agent for continuing it.
